response.overview: TV adaptation of a bestselling novel. Emile has just learned that he has early-onset Alzheimer's and only a few months left to live. Wanting to escape the hospital, the gaze of his family and friends, he decides to hit the road in an old camper van with Joanne, the girl who answered his ad. For her, it's an unexpected opportunity to flee a life that had become unbearable. Their improvised destination: the Pyrenees.
response.title: All the blue in the sky
